summary: The DGA info field: one labelled read-only value with an optional decorative icon, for detail and profile pages. Lay several out in a CSS grid; wide spans a full row.

inputs.name: icon
inputs.description: Decorative leading icon in a circle.

inputs.name: valueDir
inputs.description: Writing direction of the value; ltr keeps phone numbers and codes readable inside RTL text.

inputs.name: wide
inputs.description: Spans the full row of a CSS grid.

inputs.name: align
inputs.description: Vertical alignment of icon and text; start suits multi-line values.

slots.description: The value, formatted by the caller (with its own empty fallback).

a11y: The host is role=group named by its label (aria-labelledby), so the label is read with the value. The icon is decorative. valueDir isolates a left-to-right value inside RTL text.
